content_html:
Blyg Business!

I’m at a leadership retreat with a client and it suddenly struck me that Blygger is actually perfect for improving business communications radically. Things like Yammer (Twitter for business) never really took off. Slack is an expensive and unnecessarily centralized lock-in solution that is now fraught with AI data risk.

An internal network of blygs is a perfect solution. It’s a decentralized, opt-in pursue network with proper tracking and accountability. It’s fully open source.

Those of us who are indie consultants can offer consulting for internal comms architecture using Blygger without the conflict of interest of being software vendors trying to lock people into services.

We can discuss and develop this idea in SIGfB on the PI discord.

This seems pretty reasonable. It wouldn't be that hard to do blygs on private GitHub repos. It would likely have to be stuff that's not super sensitive and wouldn't be the end of the world if share. More frieNDA than nsa.

There are also web3 ish org stuff I'd venture or civic stuff on hacker fund that would benefit from blygging. There's a mutual aid network on hacker fund. There's also a big network of fire safety councils in California that come to mind.

Another reason I'm excited to get more engage with the protocols business sig. Just need to square away my life logistics.
